name: save_version_reject
description: Save compatibility (docs/save-format.md): the loader rejects any version != SAVE_VERSION (equality check in save_valid_at_slot), so v2 and older saves never decode stale loot ids. Save with GOLD 50, gain 25, backdate slot 1's version byte (0xA002) to 2, load -- GOLD must stay 75: the load is refused and state is untouched. Pairs with save_version_accept.
